title: [New+] Not able to create new files in folders that require higher privilege
author: noraa-junker

judgment.rationale: The New+ failure is maintainer-reproduced and deterministic: creating a template in a protected folder prompts for elevation but does not create the file, sometimes leaving the progress UI stuck. This is sufficient for an elevation/operation design investigation.
evidence: The report provides numbered Program Files reproduction steps and a screenshot of the elevation prompt.
A second maintainer-side confirmation says the template is not created, even when the dialog does not freeze.
The issue is labeled reproducible, Priority-1, Cost-Medium, and Product-New+.
judgment.recommended_action: Queue a New+ design for completing the protected-folder copy through a correctly elevated operation and reporting failures.

fix_assessment.rationale: The defect is reproducible, but the lightweight pass did not inspect the current shell/elevation implementation deeply enough for a full design.

proposed_fixes.title: Complete New+ template creation through an elevated file operation
proposed_fixes.root_cause: New+ starts a protected-folder copy that triggers elevation, but the operation does not complete or propagate a useful failure result back to the New+ progress flow.
plan: Trace the template copy handoff through the shell/elevation boundary for protected destinations.
Execute the copy in the elevated operation context and propagate success, cancellation, and failure explicitly.
Ensure the progress UI always completes and reports a concrete error instead of hanging.
verification: Create a template in Program Files, approve elevation, and confirm the file is created.
Repeat with elevation cancelled and with a deliberate name conflict and confirm deterministic UI completion.

confidence.rationale: The protected-folder boundary is maintainer-reproduced, but the public evidence does not identify the exact failed handoff or API.

issue_context.summary: New+ accepts an elevation prompt for protected folders but fails to create the selected template.
known_information: Program Files is a confirmed target.
The file is not created after Continue.
The progress dialog may freeze, but failure also occurs without the freeze.
inferences: The elevated copy/operation handoff likely does not complete or report failure, but this is not proven.
issue_context.analysis: The issue should move to code-level elevation-path design rather than wait for more author data.
initial_investigation: Reviewed the current public issue body, labels, assignees, and up to the latest 20 public comments returned by GitHub.
Kept the existing dashboard read-only; no dashboard files were modified or published.

actions.label: Approve complete new+ template creation through an elevated file operation
actions.note: Approve/start the fork-side design workflow from this public-evidence fix plan. No upstream write occurs from this action.

actions.label: Reproduce [New+] Not able to create new files in folders that require higher privilege
actions.note: Maintainer-side reproduction reduces the recorded implementation uncertainty without asking the reporter to perform code investigation.

prerequisites: A destination such as Program Files that requires elevation.
steps: Choose the template from the New+ context menu.
Wait for the file operation to complete.
reproduce.expected_result: The template is created and progress closes.
reproduce.observed_result: The template is not created and the progress UI may freeze.
